name: Yachoo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yachoo Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive design, manufacturing, and distribution of rubber tracks and pads. These essential components are engineered for a diverse range of heavy-duty equipment, including machinery utilized in agricultural, construction, snow removal, firefighting, and military applications. The company's product offerings primarily include specialized rubber tracks for engineering and agricultural vehicles, as well as various types of rubber pads. In addition, Yachoo delivers supplementary products and extensive support services tailored for the construction and agricultural sectors. Founded in 1991, this Taizhou, China-based company was previously known as Zhejiang Yuanchuang Rubber Track Co.,Ltd.
